claims.content: To decompress the contents of a selected compressed archive and extract them in a folder.

goal.raw_text: To decompress the contents of a selected compressed archive and extract them in a folder.

claims.content: User
A compressed archive has been selected by the User.
The selected archive is of one of the supported for extraction by PeaZip formats.
The User sets off the Decompression/Extraction function in the extraction window.

trigger.raw_text: The User sets off the Decompression/Extraction function in the extraction window.

claims.content: The User accesses the Extract Interface, which can be reached via 'Go to extraction layout' or the 'Extract' toolbar button.
The Extract Interface receives input from the 'Drag and Drop Feature'.
A 'Graphic display of currently executed functions' feeds back into the Extract Interface.
Two progress bars are shown: one gray and one blue.
Buttons labeled 'Explore' and 'Ok' are presented at the bottom.

At step 0, instead of accessing the Extract Interface, the User can extract files from the PeaZip archive into the “Documents” folder via the context menu in File Explorer, with the option 'Extract from pea.zip-2.7.beta.WINDOWS.zip to Documents'.
At step 0, the User can set off extraction using 'Extract all content' - Ctrl+A.
At step 0, the User can set off extraction using 'Extract displayed content' - Ctrl+D.
At step 0, the User can set off extraction using 'Extract selected content' - Ctrl+S.
At step 0, the User can set off extraction using 'Extract to new folder' (functions same as previous ones) - Ctrl+Alt+A/D/S.
At step 0, the User can set off extraction using 'Extract selected' - Ctrl+Enter.
At step 0, the User can set off extraction using 'Extract selected to new folder' - Shift+Enter.
1. If the selected archive is not of one of the supported for extraction by PeaZip formats, decompression/extraction cannot be completed; the use case exits without extracting the archive contents.

2. If the selected archive is encrypted and the User does not know or does not insert the required password and (if there is one) keyfile, access to the archive contents for extraction is not granted; the use case exits without extraction.
3. In the Extraction Interface, if a homonym file or archive exists in the selected storage space, the User defines what should happen; the exception path exits after this handling is defined.
The contents of the selected compressed archive have been decompressed and extracted in a folder.
The archive whose contents are extracted is neither destroyed, nor deleted and is not left empty.
The archive retains its content and name and remains saved at the same place of the computer system that was initially stored.
If the selected archive is encrypted, the correct password and (if existing) keyfile for authentication were inserted.
